method: One fresh process per scenario, owner creation to first embedding, 5 warm-up batches then 200 sequential batches of 2 typical memory/message texts; 384-dimensional outputs. RSS after batch 200. Native telemetry disabled for both transports at process birth.
limits: Process-cold, not disk-cold; excludes host program startup, parent module imports and downloads.
RSS sums processes and double-counts shared pages; not PSS or unique physical memory.
Single final run per scenario; earlier exploratory cold measurements varied materially.
Default ORT threading retained; the 4-vCPU sandbox emitted CPU-affinity warnings.
